name: ci-monitor
title: 在显示器上
description: Monitor and interact with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Check build status, trigger builds, analyze failed jobs, view logs. Use when: (1) checking build/pipeline status, (2) triggering test builds, (3) analyzing CI failures, (4) monitoring deployment status, (5) "查看构建状态", "Jenkins", "流水线", "CI失败了", "触发构建". Requires: curl for API calls. Jenkins needs JENKINS_URL and JENKINS_TOKEN env vars. NOT for: configuring CI pipelines (edit Jenkinsfile/yaml directly), or managing infrastructure.
